name: Wide-9 Under Front Tackle-Wrap Stunt (T-E)
situation: 2nd & 7, +35, standard pass down with play-action threat
coverage: Cover 3 Sky Match (Single-High with Wide-9 Rush)

summary.motive: Exploit the Wide-9 alignment by forcing offensive tackles into elongated kick-slides, then executing a Tackle-End (T-E) wrap stunt to create an unblocked interior rush lane for the defensive end.
summary.whyItWorks: The threat of speed rush from the Wide-9 makes offensive tackles over-set outside, creating wide-open interior corridors when paired with an aggressive A-gap spike by the 3-technique.
summary.failureMode: Quick rhythm 3-step slants or screens thrown before the stunt can develop and loop into the backfield.

beats.title: Wide-9 Pre-Snap Alignment
beats.text: DeMeco Ryans aligns his defensive ends in extreme Wide-9 alignments outside the tackles, forcing the offensive tackles to widen their sets and opening massive interior B-gap corridors.

beats.title: T-E Stunt: 3T Spikes Inside, SDE Sells Edge
beats.text: At the snap, 3T crashes violently into the A-gap, taking the LG and Center with him. SDE takes two hard upfield steps in Wide-9, baiting the RT to overset to the sideline.

beats.title: Tackle-Wrap Loop Opens Highway to QB
beats.text: With the RT overset and the LG pinned inside by the 3T spike, SDE plants his outside foot and wraps tightly into the vacated B-gap untouched.

beats.title: SDE Arrives for the Decisive Sack
beats.text: The QB hits the top of his drop only to find SDE roaring through the interior pocket at full speed for a dominant 4-man pressure sack.

relations.tell: Wide-9 DE takes an exaggerated outside step before looping sharply inside behind the interior 3-technique spike
